intro: Slovenia has only about two million people, who are known for their love of the outdoors, beekeeping and sport.

chapters.title: People and language
text: Ljubljana is the capital and largest city. Slovene has a rare feature: besides singular and plural, it has a special 'dual' form for exactly two of something. Italian and Hungarian minorities have guaranteed rights, and most Slovenes are Catholic.

chapters.title: A nation of beekeepers
text: Beekeeping is a national tradition, with painted beehive panels, and the Carniolan honeybee comes from Slovenia. At Slovenia's suggestion, the UN made 20 May World Bee Day.

keyTerms.meaning: A grammatical form for exactly two of something.
